transcription.source: https://www.ww1ciphers.com/message/nara-rg242-t1022-r1061-0035-vb and NARA frame 35 TIFF, checked with Codex

system.summary: Five-digit Verkehrsbuch code groups with Schieber I substitution on the middle three digits.

solution.what: Compared the site’s printed groups with manuscript frame 35.
The adjacent forwarding draft gives Unterseeboot. Known VB 65873 paired with 67683 fixes 376.
Applied the substitution to 43 group occurrences and checked the 26 exact published matches.
Located the partial fleet and headquarters copies and then the complete typewritten decipherment in roll 1056.
Checked the complete German text against frame 800 and distinguished observed digits from restorations.

validation.notes: The recovered key is a three-wheel digit substitution over fixed Verkehrsbuch group numbers. A plaintext letter n-gram shuffle tests a different model. The documented control and 26 attested group occurrences check the setting.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The forwarding draft two frames before the ciphertext supplied a crib for Schieber I setting 376 alongside previously published Verkehrsbuch values. The complete reading follows the contemporary decipherment in the separate Admiralty Staff aviation file.
outcome.fraction_read_source: All four paragraphs are legible in decryption.txt. The 43 positions are aligned in reading.tsv.

credits.note: German Admiralty Staff typewritten decipherment, used for the complete text.

reading_review.note: All four paragraphs are coherent in German and were checked against the typewritten copy.

texts.summary: Great Headquarters discusses submarine support in the Firth of Forth and off Dunkirk and Boulogne, the VIII Flotilla’s temporary Baltic assignment, and protection of the airship hangars at Namur.
